name: Claude Theme
description: 非官方 Claude 风格纯声明式主题，提供浅色与深色两套配色。
author: B1eight
safetyNotes: 纯声明式主题，仅 ui.theme。空生命周期；不注入脚本、不访问网络、不注册工具、不更改宿主或其他插件行为。不内嵌字体，排版使用系统字体族。切换主题即可恢复；不含 Anthropic 专有资产。

en.name: Claude Theme
en.description: Unofficial Claude-inspired declarative light and dark themes for PI-Desktop.
en.safetyNotes: Declarative themes only; ui.theme is the only permission. No runtime behavior, network, tools or changes to other plugins. No embedded fonts: typography uses system families. Switch themes to revert. No proprietary Anthropic assets.
